verdict.rationale: Jitsu doesn't offer an explicit 'choose your region' toggle in its cloud product, but its open-source, self-hostable nature (Kubernetes/Helm, on-prem deployment, Private Cloud/On-Prem pricing tiers) means customers can control where data physically resides by hosting it themselves. This is a workaround rather than a native region-selection feature in Jitsu Cloud. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selector for Jitsu Cloud customers, documented list of supported hosting regions, and independent confirmation of residency compliance beyond self-hosting.
